title: ASD
summary: A small Python script that loads an ARFF-format autism spectrum disorder (ASD) dataset and generates synthetic tabular data for it, ending with a quality evaluation of the synthetic output. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and evaluate_quality are directly imported and run to produce and score the synthetic ASD data.
